Sandbox_BatmanTT_AimingXpPerHit_tooltip: Aiming experience for each target hit, before the target and zone bonuses (can stand x1.5, target stand x1.25, bullseye x1.5, inner ring x1.25). Vanilla multipliers (books, traits) still apply.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_MeleeXpPerHit_tooltip: Weapon skill experience for each blow on the training dummy (axe, blunt, spear, blades).
Sandbox_BatmanTT_MinShootingDistance_too: Shots from closer than this many tiles do not count.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_HitChanceBonus_tooltip: Added to the chance of hitting a target, in percent (negative values make training harder).
Sandbox_BatmanTT_SheetDurability_tooltip: Hits a target sheet takes before it must be replaced.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_DummyDurability_tooltip: Blows the training dummy takes before it must be repaired, counted in baseball bat blows. Heavy weapons such as axes wear it up to 3 times faster, knives 5 times slower.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_MaxCans_tooltip: Maximum number of empty cans on the can stand (1 to 6).
Sandbox_BatmanTT_MeleeTraining_tooltip: The training dummy gives weapon skill experience.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_VanillaTargets_tooltip: The military shooting targets found in the world can be used for training.
Sandbox_BatmanTT_SessionTimeout_tooltip: A shooting session ends after this many real minutes without a shot at a target. 0: never.
